events.title: Tupac Shakur's death anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot dead in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 today. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's death anniversary
events.blurb: Guitar icon Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 today. His revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles released 'Abbey Road'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles crossed that iconic zebra crossing and gave us 'Abbey Road'. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Sending happy 75th birthday wishes to the legendary Chrissie Hynde. Still rocking and still inspiring!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude.

events.title: John Lennon released 'Imagine'
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. A powerful message that resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: The first iPod was released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped 25 years ago? It changed everything for music lovers. What was your first playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the iconic John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy giant.

events.title: The Beatles released 'The White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that proved their incredible versatility.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's death anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a significant shift in their sound and influence.
